decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge to deal direct damage and control the board with cards like Static Prison. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide additional creature support, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer offer card advantage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride. With a mix of burn, creature aggression, and disruption, this deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through efficient removal and counterspells while generating card advantage through graveyard manipulation. The deck aims to control the game by eliminating threats with cards like Fatal Push and Sink into Stupor, countering key spells with Counterspell and Force of Negation, and recycling resources with Thought Scour and Unearth. Murktide Regent serves as a win condition by presenting a fast clock, while Shoot the Sheriff and Graveyard Trespasser provide additional disruption to slow down the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through using Eldrazi creatures and ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents' strategies, while also having access to big creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, the deck aims to overpower opponents and dominate the battlefield. With a mix of control elements, mana ramp, and powerful Eldrazi creatures, this deck offers a versatile and dynamic playstyle in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly play powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with removal spells and disruption. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while keeping their own board clear and disrupting their strategy. By utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Return, along with efficient mana ramp and Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer, while utilizing lands such as Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to generate additional value. The goal is to ramp into Primeval Titan and utilize its ability to search for lands like Vesuva and Gruul Turf, which can then be used to generate immense amounts of mana and potentially win the game with cards like Scapeshift or Valakut triggers. The deck also includes cards like Lotus Field and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to further enhance its mana production capabilities.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Tidehollow Sculler and Skyclave Apparition. Aether Vial is used to cheat creatures into play at instant speed, while Fatal Push helps to remove key threats. Ephemerate provides additional value by flickering creatures for repeated effects. The deck also utilizes a mix of creatures with different abilities to keep the opponent off balance and outpace them in the race to victory.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on maintaining card advantage through Thought Scour, Counterspell, Force of Negation, and other spells while using creatures like Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas as threats. Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus provide additional utility and disruption, while cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Unearth help manage the graveyard and provide recursion options. The deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spells and creatures without relying on lands to achieve its win condition. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal, Lotus Bloom, and Thundertrap Trainer, the player can control the board and disrupt their opponent's strategy while working towards setting up a powerful combo using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Suppression Ray. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of control and combo elements, ultimately securing victory through a well-timed and coordinated series of plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows the player to mill their own deck, retrieve spells from their graveyard, and ultimately win the game with a specific win condition such as Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes various support cards such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to help set up the combo efficiently. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a burst of card advantage and a game-winning sequence of plays.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by utilizing a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. By controlling the game through card advantage and tempo plays, the deck aims to prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push, Counterspell, and Unearth allows for efficient removal and graveyard recursion, while cards like Sink into Stupor and Abhorrent Oculus provide additional disruption. Overall, the deck aims to control the flow of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Ugin's Labyrinth, Utopia Sprawl, and Talismans to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck also features cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return for board control. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive Eldrazi threats while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It includes a mix of powerful creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Orcish Bowmasters and Arena of Glory to provide additional flexibility in different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and finish the game quickly before they can stabilize.

The main goal of this deck is to assemble a variety of creature cards through the use of tutoring effects like Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling. These creatures are then used in combination with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create powerful synergies and generate value. The deck also includes cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the board. Overall, the deck aims to create a versatile and resilient toolbox of creatures to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phalage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly build up pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes powerful spells like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge to deal direct damage to the opponent. With cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls providing support and buffs for the creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Static Prison and Arena of Glory helps control the board and maintain aggression throughout the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo without relying on lands. It uses cards like Hydroelectric Specimen, Thundertrap Trainer, and Tameshi, Reality Architect to generate mana and disrupt opponents. By utilizing cards like Whir of Invention and Sink into Stupor, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to win the game. Disrupting Shoal and Flare of Denial provide additional disruption against opponent's plays, while Goblin Charbelcher acts as the win condition. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Underworld Breach with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill through your deck rapidly and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to help fuel the combo, while also running disruption like Spell Snare and Unholy Heat to control the game. With the help of Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck aims to set up its win condition quickly and efficiently, overwhelming the opponent with its powerful combo potential.
